message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to your account management system from this interface, so I can’t directly update your password.  
If you need to reset or change your password, please log into your account through our website’s “Account Settings” (or “Change Password”) section, or contact customer support for assistance.
message.reasoning:
The user wants to "update my credentials" with new password. But we have no tool for updating credentials; only a login/authenticate function exists. There's no mention of ability to change password. We should respond politely explaining limitation.

We can ask clarifying question or suggest they use account settings page. Probably best to say cannot do it here.
